Resolve each table skill group through the full skill catalogue: axe/mace dexterity-5, flail-4 or two-handed axe/mace-3; flail dexterity-6, axe/mace-4 or two-handed flail-3; energy blade dexterity-5 or sword skill-3; cord dexterity-4; knife dexterity-4, energy blade-3, parrying dagger-3 or short blade-3; weighted chain dexterity-6, filament whip-3, two-handed flail-4 or whip-3; lance dexterity-5 or spear-3; filament whip dexterity-6, weighted chain-3 or whip-3; polearm dexterity-5, spear-4, staff-4 or two-handed axe/mace-4. Broad-blade defaults are dexterity-5, energy blade-4, rapier-4, fencing saber-4, short blade-2 or two-handed sword-4. Do not bypass default-chain restrictions.
Throwable attack modes use the ranged table rather than reusing melee damage/range blindly.
Piercing pick-like attacks may lodge in the target; use B405 stuck-weapon procedure and ownership state.

Brawling improves the listed unarmed attacks; boxing improves punches; karate and claws improve punches/kicks, but claw benefits do not apply through knuckle reinforcement or boots. Apply source-specific skill thresholds and bonuses once.
Missed kicks require dexterity to avoid falling. Resolve miss first, then the separate balance consequence.

Failed health resistance causes stun while electrical contact persists plus twenty minus health seconds, then health-minus-three recovery checks. This overrides the abbreviated example duration; own contact and release timestamps and resolve nonpositive extra time explicitly.
Flail defenses take parry -4 and block -2; fencing weapons cannot parry. Linked short clubs halve numeric penalties, preserving the explicit fencing restriction unless another rule overrides it.

Energy blade requires a ready action to activate/deactivate, cannot break and damages weapons/body parts it parries or that parry/block it. Replacement cell costs one hundred, weighs half a pound and powers three hundred seconds; own active-time consumption.
Strangling cord uses the B405 grappling/strangulation procedure, not ordinary thrust damage.
Mounted lance damage changes during a charge under B397, tied to actual mount speed and attack state.
Guarded short blade hilt can act as knuckle reinforcement in close combat without buying a second weapon.
Powered cutting tool is noisy and operates two hours on half a gallon fuel; track runtime and actual fuel.
Ordinary whip maximum reach is selected at purchase up to seven yards. Cost/weight are per yard and minimum strength is five plus length in yards. B406 special rules still apply.

Listed muscle-powered melee/thrown prices buy ordinary quality through technology six, fine quality at seven or higher. Record item quality separately from price and technology; powered/natural attacks do not automatically gain blade quality bonuses.
Cheap quality gives +2 breakage checks and throwable accuracy -1. Price is forty percent of list through technology six or twenty percent at seven-plus.
Ordinary quality has no breakage modifier; at technology seven-plus it costs forty percent of listed price.

Fine quality gives breakage -1 and +1 cutting/impaling blade damage. Through technology six, sword/fencing items cost four times list; other crushing/impaling-only weapons three times, cutting-capable weapons ten times. At seven-plus fine is listed price. Apply quality by mode damage type without duplicating physical-item cost.
Exceptional quality is limited to sword/fencing items, with breakage -2 and +2 cutting/impaling damage. Price is twenty times list through technology six or four times at seven-plus.
Presentation decoration adds an authored five-to-twenty-times cost/resale multiplier without implied combat improvement. Define exact price and interaction with quality explicitly.
